column1: # Authored numeric inputs only; no client assets. Ground uses source flat-height dispatch/body.
# Scope excludes area/zone overrides, TerrainInfo, VMAP liquid selection and gameplay admission.
# Missing lookup IDs 0,20,77,78 are genuinely absent from that table; every area lookup aborts.
# Cell tables are row-major 16*16; profile 6 replaces flags[i] with zero.
# Profile columns: id global_entry global_flags offX offY width height flat_level_bits type_table height_map zero_flags
# All queries select tile 32,32. All *_bits are hexadecimal binary32; other columns are decimal.
# NO_WATER preserves every data sentinel; wants_data=0 also preserves them for nonzero status.
# Ground -200000 is the source INVALID_HEIGHT_VALUE supplied as a scalar, not a hole-interpolation proof.
